responsibility: This definition module declares the minimal file-output interface for a single `CHAR` value in the gm2 base libraries. It belongs to the text I/O convenience layer over `FIO`, exporting `Write` for one character and `WriteLn` for a newline, and serves as the primitive output building block reused by higher-level string-writing modules such as `String`.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the CHAR pair: it declares the single-character output API, while `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/CHAR.mod` supplies the concrete forwarding to `FIO.WriteChar` and `FIO.WriteLine`.
